title: Israel CRESTA codes
text:
Israel 
CRESTA
 codes

Touchstone
 supports the following 
CRESTA
 codes for Israel.

| CRESTA Code | CRESTA Name |
| --- | --- |
| ISR_M | Central |
| ISR_HA | Haifa |
| ISR_JM | Jerusalem |
| ISR_Z | Northern |
| ISR_D | Southern |
| ISR_TA | Tel Aviv |
| ISR_X | West Bank |
